content.title: 2026 RBC Heritage purse: Payout breakdown, winner's share
content.text: Scottie Scheffler trails Matt Fitzpatrick by three shots heading into the final round of the 2026 RBC Heritage. Getty Images The 2026 RBC Heritage is set for a dramatic conclusion as two of the game’s hottest players battle for their second respective titles at Harbour Town.For tournament leader Matt Fitzpatrick (-17), Hilton Head is a place filled with happy childhood vacation memories — and a victory in 2023, when he won a playoff against Jordan Spieth. A win today would mark the fourth of his PGA Tour career.For his closest adversary, Scottie Scheffler (-14), a win at Harbour Town would mark his second in three appearances, after winning the 2024 edition by three shots. Matt Fitzpatrick has flipped script on Scottie Scheffler at RBC — but 1 task remains By: Josh Schrock Both Scheffler and Fitzpatrick are seeking their second wins of the 2026 season. And in addition to the title, there’s also a boatload of money up for grabs.Thanks to the RBC Heritage’s Signature Event status, a total purse of $20 million will be distributed to the field’s 82 players, with $3.6 million going to the winner.
